# Board-wide Raspberry Pi firmware settings, included by config.txt.
# config.txt itself is generated by rpi-bootc-bootloader; put your changes here.
[all]
# Serial console on the Pi 5's 3-pin debug UART (ttyAMA10).
enable_uart=1
# Standard KMS display driver for HDMI.
dtoverlay=vc4-kms-v3d
disable_overscan=1
